桌椅、壁紙、地毯、擺飾…所有家具都透過隨機合成獲得，每次合成都像開盲盒一樣充滿驚喜！你可以自由規劃佈置，搭配古典雅緻、簡約時尚、浪漫童話、田園鄉村等不同主題，打造獨一無二的森系小店。從室內裝潢到花園種植收集鮮花，每個角落都由你決定。

店員不只是幫手，還能換裝搭配當季流行服飾。甜美、幹練、華麗、簡約…各種風格隨心切換。收集限定時裝，提升店鋪魅力值，吸引更多客人上門。解鎖每一位店員的人物小傳，與店員互動培養親密度，讓每一次換裝都充滿樂趣與成就感。

🐷 Screw Rescue — Match Two, Set Piggy Free! 🐷

Poor little piggy is trapped behind metal plates. Each plate is held in place by two screws. Your mission? Remove every screw and let the pig run free!

🎨 Match the Colors
Tap two screws of the same color, and they disappear together. Get the colors right, and the plates start falling apart. Get it wrong? Those screws stay stuck.

📦 5 Slots for Screws
Under the plates, there are 5 storage slots. When you tap a screw, it moves down into an empty slot, waiting for its matching partner. But if all 5 slots fill up with mismatched screws… you’re stuck. You’ll need to plan carefully and clear pairs before the slots overflow.

🧠 Trickier Every Level
At first, it’s simple — a few plates, clear colors. But as you progress, more colors appear, and the metal plates twist into crazy shapes. Some screws hide behind others. You’ll need sharp eyes and quick thinking to keep the slots from jamming.

挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

Welcome to King City: Open World - an action packed open world driving simulator where you choose how to play. 🚗🌆

Explore a lively urban map inspired by Indian city vibes, packed with traffic, public places, local style, and sandbox freedom. Drive across the city, earn money, customize your look, upgrade your rides, and enjoy an open world that feels alive on mobile.

✨ WHAT YOU CAN DO
🛺🚕🚌 Drive & Earn (Jobs)
Start your journey with Auto Rickshaw, Taxi, and Bus missions. Pick up passengers, follow traffic rules, reach destinations, and earn in-game cash to build your city lifestyle.

🏍️🚗 45+ Vehicles to Drive
Enjoy a massive driving simulator experience with 45+ vehicles. Choose from cars, bikes, scooters, auto rickshaws, taxis, buses, tractors, trucks, and more, then switch rides anytime and explore the city your way.

🎨 Garage + Vehicle Color Customization
Take your vehicles to the garage and change their colors to match your style. Give your favorite rides a fresh look before heading back to the streets.
